analysis.reasonEn: RSI declined from 60.4 to 57.0, maintaining a neutral range. MACD histogram turned negative but shows improvement. Volume ratio at 0.37x the 5-day average indicates contraction. 52-week position at 14.1% remains low. The 5-day high of $0.26 and low of $0.24 form a narrow range. Weekly ADX at 22.7 suggests an early stage of trend formation. Overall, a wait-and-see approach is maintained due to lack of directional momentum and low volume.

[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (60.4→57.0) + 중립 구간 지속 중 + 하락 방향성
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (0.0026→-0.0010) + 개선 진단 + 약세 수렴 신호

· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 관망 조건 유지
analysis.narrativeEn:

· Above SMA100 ($0.19)/SMA200 ($0.21) - medium to long-term trend strength is good.

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (60.4→57.0) + staying neutral + downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.0026→-0.0010) + improvement diagnosis + bearish convergence signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $0.24) + band width at 33.28% indicates moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.24) + based on pivot/swing low/moving averages.
· Swing resistance ($0.26) + breakout expected to signal upward trend.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (consolidation) + no trend reversal signal confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.37x) + low confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation phase) + wait-and-see conditions maintained.
